text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 15, "unit": "oranges", "kind": "count", "span": "Will buys 15 oranges"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 8, "unit": "years", "kind": "count", "span": "the oldest son is 8 years old"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 0.5, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "the youngest is half as old as the oldest"}], "plan": [{"op": "mul", "args": ["q2", "q3"], "out": "s1", "note": "the youngest son's age, half the oldest's"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q2", "s1"], "out": "s2", "note": "oranges washed: each son washes as many as his age"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q1", "s2"], "out": "s3", "note": "oranges bought minus oranges washed"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "the number of oranges left unwashed"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 2, "reason": "'2 sons' counts the boys; their share of the washing is already carried by adding the two ages"}]}
